paper_title: Superradiance Exclusions in the Landscape of Type IIB String Theory
notes: Black hole superradiance (BHSR) applied to an ensemble of type IIB string compactifications. The observational exclusion (Fig. 3) is the fraction of Calabi-Yau manifolds excluded as a function of Hodge number h^1,1, and the underlying BHSR bound lives in the (axion mass m_a, self-interaction f_pert) plane (Fig. 2). BHSR is purely gravitational and does not bound any axion-SM or dark-sector coupling in the task-card table (photon, electron, nucleon, EDM, dark photon, etc.). The only appearance of g_agamma (g <~ 1e-12 - 1e-13 GeV^-1) is a discussion quoting other experiments' constraints [53-55], not a bound derived in this paper. Therefore there is no new measured limit on any canonical coupling plane; is_new_limit=false. Not a projection either: it is a real constraint, just outside the coupling planes in scope. coupling_type set to null; coupling_convention placeholder only.
